sloka: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे दशोत्तरशततमः सर्गः ।। ११० ।।
transliteration: ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe daśottaraśatatamaḥ sargaḥ ।। 110 ।।

translations.english: Seeing the victory incline to neither the son of Dasaratha nor the lord of the rakshasas in that combat, the great-souled charioteer of the king of the gods quickly spoke this word to Raghava, intent upon the battle.
